taskpack.goal: Implement the approved trusted SWE-EVO complexity projection and hierarchical local-resource enforcement, then revalidate the provider-free Phase 3B preparation path without authorizing a scored model call.
taskpack.integration_policy: Verified integration followed by operator review; no scored provider call, P3-LIVE authorization, source merge, push, or release activation.

decisions.subject: phase3b_multi_instance_pilot_preparation
decisions.statement: Prepare the approved three-instance SWE-EVO pilot without admitting scored provider calls.

alternatives.rejected_reason: Worker resource fields are not yet enforced and the official Arrow complexity proxy is not yet projected by trusted code.

alternatives.option: mutate the completed v3 or calibration taskpack
alternatives.rejected_reason: Frozen historical taskpacks must remain immutable.

decisions.rationale: The selected instances and resource contract must be reproducible and enforceable before their outputs can support a comparison claim.
decisions.expected_outcome: A reviewed v4 implementation ready to materialize live-pilot inputs under a separate P3-LIVE gate.

decisions.subject: phase3b_v4_provider_free_repair
decisions.statement: Implement and verify the approved complexity projection and resource envelope before materializing live-pilot taskpacks.

alternatives.rejected_reason: The resource-control path is not yet implemented, so development tasks remain serial for this repair.

decisions.rationale: A narrow serial repair preserves the completed v3 implementation while closing only the two newly approved preconditions.
decisions.expected_outcome: The deterministic preparation path passes with exact selection metadata and zero scored calls.

decisions.subject: phase3b_local_resource_enforcement
decisions.statement: Use equal four-CPU workload slots and grant each AgentTeam mode a separately metered four-CPU control-plane allowance under a sixteen-CPU project ceiling.

alternatives.option: give every mode the same total process-group ceiling
alternatives.rejected_reason: It would charge AgentTeam orchestration against the worker slot and artificially constrain the framework.
A runaway test or descendant process could destabilize the host and invalidate attribution.

decisions.rationale: Equal leaf workload capacity preserves task comparability while a bounded control-plane allowance lets the multi-agent system operate normally.
decisions.expected_outcome: Every descendant is bounded and terminal evidence distinguishes resource exhaustion from model-quality failure.

success_criteria: The exact SWE-EVO metadata fixture reproduces 48 rows, the 21/12/15 strata, the 20/12/15 eligible strata, and the three preview selections.
Evaluator-only PR records and complexity control metadata cannot enter worker-visible inputs.
Model worker, AgentTeam mode, project, and evaluator descendants are bound to the approved hierarchical resource envelope.
Resource exhaustion is terminal structured evidence rather than a model-quality outcome.
The provider-free integration lane passes and records zero scored provider calls.

tasks.objective: Implement a trusted projection from the fixed SWE-EVO Arrow inventory to the existing allowlisted routing manifest using dataset_pr_record_count and the approved strata.
tasks.goal_alignment: Makes complexity-stratified selection reproducible without exposing raw PR records, patches, tests, scores, or prior outcomes to runtime workers.
acceptance_criteria: The extractor verifies source commit, Arrow SHA-256, split, and 48-row count before projection.
dataset_pr_record_count is computed only as len(PRs), then discarded after assigning low 0-2, medium 3-6, or high 7-or-more.
The projection records 21/12/15 source populations and 20/12/15 eligible populations after excluding the calibration instance.
Seed 20260812 and one-per-stratum quotas reproduce the three approved preview IDs through the existing selector.
Raw PR data, proxy counts, strata, patches, tests, scores, and prior outcomes are unavailable to worker prompts; only the existing allowlisted routing manifest reaches selection control code.
Missing pyarrow or source drift fails clearly without installing dependencies or changing policy.
tasks.stop_condition: Stop if projection requires exposing evaluator-only row content to a model, deriving difficulty from outcomes, or changing the approved proxy, boundaries, seed, or exclusions.

tasks.objective: Implement and meter the approved project, mode, control-plane, workload-slot, and evaluator resource envelopes over complete descendant process trees.
tasks.goal_alignment: Prevents host exhaustion without artificially constraining AgentTeam to the total footprint of one Codex worker.
acceptance_criteria: The existing shared cpu_limit and memory_limit_bytes remain the equal four-CPU, twelve-GiB workload-slot authority.
Single Codex is bounded at one workload slot; each AgentTeam mode receives an eight-CPU, twenty-four-GiB parent envelope including one equal workload slot and its control plane.
The complete pilot is bounded by a sixteen-CPU, forty-eight-GiB project envelope with TasksMax 1024 and swap disabled.
Systemd properties are applied before execution and read back; unavailable or mismatched enforcement fails before provider admission.
Terminal evidence records CPU time, peak memory, throttling, OOM, PID, timeout, cgroup identity, and cleanup state without polling from the model prompt.
OOM, PID exhaustion, and resource-driven timeout are classified as resource_limit_exhausted and never as model-quality failure.
Historical protocols without the additive Phase 3B resource binding preserve their existing behavior and tests.
tasks.stop_condition: Stop if user-level systemd cannot represent or verify the parent/leaf hierarchy, if limits can be bypassed by descendants, or if the implementation mutates frozen historical protocol artifacts.

tasks.objective: Revalidate the complete Phase 3B provider-free preparation path with the approved complexity and resource authorities and publish updated preflight evidence.
tasks.goal_alignment: Establishes that selection and execution controls are ready for later per-instance taskpack freeze without crossing the P3-LIVE boundary.
acceptance_criteria: Focused projection, resource-envelope, model-invocation, and experiment-harness tests pass.
The complete provider-free unittest lane passes or any pre-existing unrelated baseline failure is reproduced and isolated with evidence.
Preflight verifies the approved selection preview and all resource bindings without launching a scored model call.
The report records zero scored provider calls and leaves P3-LIVE unauthorized.
No source merge, push, runtime release activation, or benchmark candidate integration occurs.
tasks.stop_condition: Stop before publishing live authorization, invoking a scored model, merging source, pushing, or activating a runtime release.
